findings.title: General verbose does not enable ACCP visibility
findings.conclusion: The general verbose flag is only forwarded into InteractiveMode startup behavior. ACCP visibility is controlled separately by terminal.verboseAccpOutput.

findings.title: Manual runs can lose the persistent ACCP result card
findings.conclusion: The final result card is only rendered when an ACCP task envelope exists. The live status card is then removed at agent_end.

findings.title: InteractiveMode overwrites the session progress-emitter handler
findings.conclusion: The live TUI handler replaces the session-side handler that persists lastAccpCompileResult, lastAccpGateVerdict, and lastAccpArtifactPath.
